method: Sum signed native contact forces between every rope link and receiver+pin assembly. Contact ordering is accounted for; reversing global sign leaves resultant magnitudes unchanged. Internal assembly forces excluded. Sum of contact norms and individual contact peak reported separately.
scope: Offline load diagnosis; no new score or unvalidated material strength inference. Existing 150 N pin/eye service and 300 N hard contact checks are not renamed as a whole-assembly norm-sum rating.
